schema_source: #1536 — thirteen fields, with loss_order and floor proposed as fourteen and fifteen and adopted here.
what: Operators registered in the #1536 schema. The five below are the resolution routes the predictions register already sorts 469 claims by; registering them makes that classification an operator taxonomy rather than a label set.

prior_registrations.note: Provenance Erasure Rate, factored into a five-stage chain.

The operative act of measurement. INTERNAL TRANSFORM NULL — it operates on standing, not on the object. The class this belongs to may be the archive's characteristic one: depositing, seating, the erratum and the effective act all leave their object identical and change what can be done with it.

standing_transition_is_bidirectional: #1536 recorded that PER sees standing REMOVED and not standing CONFERRED, and named that as its blind spot. An operator registered here must say which direction it sees.

operators.name: σ_verify — resolution by checking a surface
operators.resolution_kind: VERIFIABLE — resolves by checking a surface
operators.domain: A claim about what a named composition surface will return for a named query at a named time.
operators.codomain: A capture: transcript, surface fingerprint, auth state, timestamp, extracted citations — an object that can be compared against the claim.
operators.preconditions: The surface is reachable; the query string is stated exactly; the auth state is declared. Per the Surface Rule (MANUS, 2026-08-15) the address is the pair (string, surface).
operators.substrate: A composition layer: retrieval index, ranker, generator, rendering surface. Each surface is a distinct substrate.
operators.internal_transform: None on the claim. The operation produces an independent object against which the claim is then read.
operators.execution_coupling: Total where the capture is seated with its transcript; partial where only a figure is attested. An attested result without a transcript resolves nothing that a reader can check.
operators.labor_source: Borne by whoever runs the probe. Cheap per run and uncapped in number — which is why 201 claims sit under this kind and 419 captures exist.
operators.provenance_transition: The capture preserves the surface's own citation apparatus where the paste carries it; cite_list records what was cited and NO_SEARCH records the absence.
operators.standing_transition: Confers standing on an ephemeral composition: an output that would have vanished becomes dated, attributable and contestable. Bidirectional — a capture can also remove standing from a claim it disconfirms.
operators.invariants: The issued string and the surface. Change either and it is a different address, not another observation.
operators.failure_mode: The surface returns nothing, refuses, or is unreachable — each a reportable outcome, not a null result. A run whose transcript is not held has not executed for any reader but the operator.
operators.measurement: Seated in EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 with transcript_class, transcript_complete and transcript_read.
operators.loss_order: The eligible set is not recorded, only the cited set. A source's absence from a capture cannot distinguish ineligibility from non-selection.
operators.floor: One capture is one draw. Two runs of one system on one string have differed by 3.5x (EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01 §2.1).

operators.name: σ_collate — resolution against a source
operators.domain: A claim about what a text says, at a locus, in an edition or witness.
operators.codomain: A verdict against the printed or manuscript witness, with the locus, the edition, and the reading recorded.
operators.preconditions: The witness is identified by edition and page, not only by reference numbering. THE FAILURE THIS FIELD EXISTS FOR: a corpus can carry an edition's NUMBERING while holding a different edition's TEXT (EA-CORPORA-14/01 — Usener numbering as carried by van Raalte, First1KGreek text).
operators.substrate: A seated corpus, an edition, a manuscript, or a digital text with declared origin and normalisation.
operators.internal_transform: None on the text. The operation produces a verdict; the text is unchanged.
operators.execution_coupling: Total. A collation result changes what a subsequent reading may assert.
operators.labor_source: Borne by the collator, and it is the most expensive operator here per unit: it requires the physical or licensed witness, and cannot be run at scale or without permission.
operators.provenance_transition: Preserves and often RESTORES provenance — it is one of the few operators here whose normal effect is to increase what is attributable.
operators.standing_transition: Confers standing on a reading by binding it to a witness; removes standing from a reading the witness does not support.
operators.invariants: The locus. A collation at a different locus is a different operation.
operators.failure_mode: The witness is unavailable, unlicensed, or unextractable — as when a scanned edition yields no machine-readable Greek. A digital text that produces a non-word (ἰόνκ at 5a18) announces its own corruption; one that produces a real word does not.
operators.measurement: The verdict, the locus, the edition, and whether the check was against the printed page or a digital surrogate.
operators.loss_order: A corruption that produces a real word is invisible to this operator without a second witness.
operators.floor: One witness is not a collation.

operators.name: σ_study — resolution on a study
operators.domain: A claim that a stated protocol, run under stated conditions, will produce a stated observable.
operators.codomain: A dated result with its dispersion, its refusals recorded separately, and its confounds named.
operators.preconditions: The protocol is frozen before the run, including its equivalence criteria. OPB-01 v1.0 was superseded before it ran for declaring itself frozen while leaving 'approximately' and 'threshold' undefined.
operators.substrate: Whatever the protocol names. Usually several surfaces, several runs.
operators.execution_coupling: Total where the result is published regardless of sign; nil where only supporting results are reported.
operators.labor_source: Borne by whoever runs it, and the register states the admission rule: a result obtained by someone else is admissible on the same terms as one obtained here. Nothing requires permission.
operators.provenance_transition: Neutral on the object; the study's own provenance is the thing at stake.
operators.standing_transition: Confers on a prediction the standing of a tested claim. Bidirectional and symmetric: a disconfirmation confers as much standing as a confirmation.
operators.invariants: The frozen protocol. A run under altered conditions tests a different claim.
operators.failure_mode: Underpowered, unfrozen, or selectively reported. A median shift without a dispersion change does not by itself establish noise.
operators.measurement: Interquartile range and median absolute deviation, not standard deviation or coefficient of variation, where the distribution is skewed.
operators.loss_order: A before-and-after design cannot isolate the intervention from concurrent change in the substrate.
operators.floor: Two observations demonstrate a discrepancy, not its distribution.

operators.name: σ_construct — resolution by construction or proof
operators.resolution_kind: FORMAL — resolves by construction or proof
operators.domain: A claim that a specified object can be built, or that a stated relation holds necessarily.
operators.codomain: The built object, or the proof — either of which exceeds the power set of existing records. THIS IS THE OPERATOR THAT MAKES THE ATLAS'S OPERATION SPACE NECESSARY: its outputs are not selections.
operators.preconditions: The specification is explicit enough to be executed by someone who did not write it.
operators.substrate: The repository, the ledger, or the formal system.
operators.internal_transform: Generative. Unlike the other four, this operator's output is new material, not a verdict about existing material.
operators.execution_coupling: Total. A built object is available to every subsequent operation; an unbuilt specification is available to none.
operators.labor_source: Borne by the builder. Higher per unit than a probe, lower than a collation, and unlike a collation it requires no permission.
operators.provenance_transition: The built object inherits the specification's provenance and acquires its own execution identity. The two must not be merged.
operators.standing_transition: Confers on a specification the standing of a realized object. NOT reversible by deletion: the specification retains the standing of having been executable.
operators.invariants: The specification. A build that departs from it is a different object and should say so.
operators.failure_mode: The specification proves inexecutable, or the built object does not answer the claim. Both are results.
operators.measurement: Whether the object exists, whether it regenerates from its recipe, and whether the emitted copy matches the committed one.
operators.loss_order: A build can silently succeed while producing nothing — a green build with an empty bundle. Verification must read the output, not the exit code.
operators.floor: An object that cannot be regenerated from its recipe is an artifact, not a construction.

operators.name: σ_remeasure — resolution on a dated re-measurement
operators.resolution_kind: TEMPORAL — resolves on a dated re-measurement
operators.domain: A claim about change over time in an observable that has already been measured once.
operators.codomain: A second dated measurement, and the delta between them.
operators.preconditions: A BASELINE EXISTS AND WAS TAKEN BEFORE IT WAS NEEDED. This is the operator's binding constraint and it cannot be satisfied retroactively.
operators.substrate: The same substrate as the baseline, or the difference is uninterpretable.
operators.execution_coupling: Total where the baseline is published; nil where the baseline is reconstructed after the fact.
operators.labor_source: Borne by whoever kept the baseline — which is to say, paid in advance by someone who did not yet know what they were paying for.
operators.provenance_transition: Neutral, but the operator is the only one here that can DETECT provenance loss over time rather than at an instant.
operators.standing_transition: Confers on a change the standing of a measured trend. The Zenodo case: citation share 26% before 19 June 2026, 9% after and stable, attributable only because the eligibility change is independently dated.
operators.invariants: The measured quantity, the substrate, and the instrument. Change any and the delta measures the change in instrument.
operators.failure_mode: No baseline; uneven coverage between the two measurements; or an unattributable change — the cited set contracted but eligibility was never mapped.
operators.measurement: The delta, with coverage stated for both endpoints. cite_list coverage runs 32% to 77% by month, which confounds any share computed across them.
operators.loss_order: The eligible set at the earlier moment is not recoverable. Only externally dated eligibility changes are attributable.
operators.floor: One measurement is not a trend, and two measurements with different coverage are not a comparison.

unrouted.what: Claims for which no registered operator takes them as domain.
unrouted.why_this_is_a_finding: This is the operation-side contraction datum, parallel to the atlas's unrealizable specifications. It is larger than every classified kind except one. A claim with no resolution route is not a weak claim; it is a claim the discipline has no operator for, and that is a fact about the operator register rather than about the claim.
unrouted.next: Classify, or register the operator that would take them. Both are work; neither is bookkeeping.

not_registered: The archive's content operators, which change their object and whose outputs exceed the power set: the splice (#1596, #1597), the eight Mandala operators, translation-as-rotation, collation into a diplomatic edition, MPAI generation, rhizome emission.
The null-transform standing operators named above: deposit, seat, errata, the effective act. These share mu_PER's shape and have never been registered as a class.

counter_operator is null on all five. #1536 filled it for PER (SPXI-TLP, MPAI packets, AXN, the Capture Registry) and it is the field that makes the register a partial order. Leaving it null here is a stated gap, not an omission.
